title: How to Read a Scientific Paper
paragraphs: Scientists share their research in papers. Reading a paper can be difficult, but most papers have the same parts, so you can learn how to read them.
At the start, there is a short summary called the abstract. Then the introduction explains the question and why it is important.
The methods section explains how the scientists did the study. The results section shows what they found, often with tables and graphs. In the discussion, they explain what the results mean.
You do not need to read everything in order. Many people read the abstract, look at the graphs and then read the discussion. Always ask: how many people were in the study, and do other studies agree?
